meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: 给助手添加 Signal 频道：它以你现有手机号的次要设备身份收发 Signal 消息，支持私聊、群聊、Markdown 格式、引用回复、打字指示（仅私聊），语音消息以占位符呈现。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 Signal 频道，或在 /setup 流程中集成 Signal 时触发。

say.text: 接入我的 Signal 账号，用我的手机号收发消息
帮我添加 Signal 频道到 NanoClaw
say.note: 开始复制适配器、注册、构建并验证。

say.text: 配置 Signal，让助手能在群聊里回复我
say.note: 需先把号码加入群组并发送消息，再创建接线。

howto.what_en: Adds a Signal channel via signal-cli device-link: the assistant sends/receives Signal messages as your existing phone number. Supports DMs and groups, Markdown formatting, quoted replies, typing indicators (DMs only), and a voice-message placeholder.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add the Signal channel, or in the /setup flow when integrating Signal as a messaging channel.

say_en.text: Connect my Signal account so I can message you from my phone
say_en.note: Runs device-link setup and shows a QR.

say_en.text: Add the Signal channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, builds and validates.

say_en.text: Set up Signal so you can reply to me in a group
say_en.note: Requires group add + message before wiring.
